title: Implement add_part() and finish() using DecodedPart from yencoding
description:
Wire Assembler to the real yencoding::DecodedPart type. Integration layer between yencoding and the range/assembly logic.

Depends on: MIME-j5n.2 (scaffold), MIME-j5n.3 (range-gap), MIME-inm (yencoding crate complete)

What to do:
- add_part(&mut self, part: DecodedPart) -> Result<(), AssemblyError>:
  - Compute 0-based range: (part.begin.unwrap_or(1)-1)..(part.end.unwrap_or(part.data.len() as u64))
  - Err(OutOfRange) if range exceeds 0..total_size
  - Run overlap check (from MIME-j5n.3)
  - If data.len() != range.len(): store the part but return Err(TruncatedPart)
  - Capture whole-file crc32 from part when present
- finish(self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AssemblyError>:
  - Err(Incomplete) if !is_complete()
  - Allocate Vec<u8>(total_size), copy_from_slice each part at its offset
  - Verify crc32 if captured; Err(CrcMismatch) on mismatch
  - Return Ok(assembled_bytes)
- Acceptance: cargo test -p yencoding-multi passes
close_reason: Assembler::add_part() uses DecodedPart part_begin/part_end. finish() returns Vec<u8>.
